story.text: Frank and Jane were secretly {ENGAGED} all along! And Harriet hopes for Mr. Knightley himself. It darts through Emma with the speed of an {ARROW}: Mr. Knightley must marry no one but {HERSELF}. In the {SHRUBBERY} he comes to {CONSOLE} her for Frank, and stays to ask his question. “If I {LOVED} you less, I might be able to talk about it more.”
story.caption: He stopped to look the question
